datasets.title: Nigeria: JIAF Humanitarian Needs People in Need and Severity
datasets.description: This dataset contains the overall people in need and intersectoral severity by disaggregation level which Includes administrative divisions and population groups, depending on each country's decision. The dataset is produced by the United Nations for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) in collaboration with humanitarian partners using the Joint Intersectoral Analysis Framework(JIAF).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/nga-jiaf-humanitarian-needs-pin-and-severity]

entity.name: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA)

lineage.description: The dataset aggregates humanitarian needs assessments from multiple partner organizations using the Joint Intersectoral Analysis Framework (JIAF) methodology, which synthesizes sectoral and intersectoral analyses to produce overall people in need and severity classifications disaggregated by administrative divisions and population groups across Nigeria.

sources.name: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA)
